provenance.source: Teaching simulation, not a validated instrument or a real survey
provenance.missingRule: EFA: listwise six-item complete cases, 221/240; CFA/SEM: new complete ordinal sample, 400/400

parallel.method: Independent within-column permutation; polychoric correlation; SMC diagonal; 95th percentile

sem.model:
R =~ R1 + R2 + R3
        T =~ T1 + T2 + T3
S =~ S1 + S2 + S3
  T ~ a*R
  S ~ b*T + c*R
  indirect := a*b
  total := c+a*b
